summary.intent: Create and execute PLAN.md files for roadmap phase 68.2 (SDK-owned read chain and resolved folder listings) via the GSD plan-phase and execute-phase workflows, then spin up a parallel git worktree to start independent phase 69 work.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.2 planning completed end-to-end (research, Nyquist VALIDATION.md, D-07 scope decision, pattern mapping, REQUIREMENTS registration, 12 plans in 7 waves, plan-checker PASS, coverage gates passed) and committed; execution began with Wave 1 running in a subagent. A separate git worktree was created off origin/main for phase 69 to be planned/executed independently in a new session.

repo: In plan-phase §5.6, the UI capability's ui-plan-gate check can report block:true, but the gate only actually fires if a `ui` hook is present in activeHooks — always cross-check activeHooks before treating block:true as blocking.

The gsd-tools commit helper can report `commit_failed` even when the commit succeeded (lint-staged completes fine) — treat this as a known false negative and verify with `git log`/`git status` rather than retrying.
Intel API-SURFACE extraction (§7.9) returns 0 symbols for this monorepo — it's HINT-only; omit it from planner prompts rather than passing empty/noisy output.
The schema-gate planner contribution is orchestrator-evaluated and should be skipped when a phase touches no ORM/DB schema files (e.g. phases scoped to packages/sdk, sdk-core, apps/web).

Worktree executors in this monorepo need their own `pnpm install`, which is expensive per worktree — for phases with mostly single-plan waves, sequential execution on the main tree is more robust than driving multi-wave worktree create/merge/cleanup from a background orchestrator.

Before dispatching executors into worktrees, verify `worktree.baseRef` — if it defaults to `origin/main` (`fresh`) instead of `head`, executors would fork without the branch's PLAN.md commits; must confirm baseRef is `head` when the phase's plans were just committed.

The gap-analysis plan-post check (`gap-analysis.plan-post`) can have unparseable control characters in its `rendered` field — fall back to running the check directly rather than relying on the wrapped/rendered output.

D-07's literal wording ("no raw IPFS/IPNS access anywhere in apps/web/src") can sweep in off-path pockets (e.g. BYO-pinning settings, auth-bootstrap/device-registry crypto) beyond what the primary success criteria mention — worth flagging as an explicit scope decision rather than assuming narrow interpretation.
workflow: In GSD's research-only mode, `--view` is the cheapest option for a correction-without-replanning loop since it only prints existing RESEARCH.md without spawning any agent.
When a user picks 'auto-advance' past a checkpoint with known non-blocking warnings, log the gap as a todo before launching the next stage rather than silently dropping it.

To parallelize independent work while staying in the current checkout, use plain `git worktree add` (not an EnterWorktree tool that would migrate the current session) so the orchestrator can keep driving the original branch while a second workstream proceeds elsewhere.

When creating a worktree intended to be a clean base, verify it doesn't inadvertently carry stray artifacts from the current branch — check for uncommitted changes and confirm any suspicious files are legitimately part of the base ref, not contamination.

friction: `git fetch` failed from the sandboxed session (no network access to GitHub), requiring reliance on the last-known local origin/main ref instead of a fresh fetch.
Commit helper's `commit_failed` status is a known false negative, requiring manual git log verification after every commit to confirm success.
gap-analysis plan-post check output contained control characters that broke the parser, forcing a fallback to running the check directly.
Intel API-surface extraction produced 0 symbols/empty output for this monorepo, adding a dead-end step before it could be excluded from the planner prompt.
open_items: D-03's poll-invalidation leg lacks automated behavioral test coverage (only grep-based verification) — logged as todo `.planning/todos/pending/2026-07-06-d03-poll-invalidation-lacks-automated-coverage.md` for future gap closure.

Phase 69 (FUSE + WinFsp Rust integration) worktree is ready at cipher-box-phase69 but planning has not started — user needs to run /gsd-discuss-phase 69 (recommended due to under-specified grant-root scope algo and unresolved FUSE delete authority model), then /gsd-plan-phase 69 and /gsd-execute-phase 69 in a new session.
Offered but not yet done: copying phase 68.2's CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md into the phase-69 worktree as reference material to support the design-mirroring dependency between the two phases.

Phase 68.2 execution (Waves 2-7) still in progress at time of transcript end — remaining waves (listing API, write facade + desync e2e, web rewire + store collapse, off-path pockets, service deletion + grep gate, mirror revert + full web-e2e gate) need to be driven to completion and reported.
